combo_label: Cars & Driving × Wine & Vineyards × Agatha Christie

entries.clue: Alphabetical run of killings, tied to an old railway guide of that name
Cushion that bursts from the steering hub in a head-on smash
Hooped wooden vessel in which a vintage quietly matures
Signed document read after a funeral, often the reason there was one
Blade-carrying arm that sweeps a windscreen clear in a downpour
Oil-holding pan bolted under the cylinders, drained through a plug at a service
Apple-bobbing October night; Christie set a 1969 drowning at such a party
Elderly amateur sleuth of St Mary Mead, underestimated by every policeman
Unlawful killing with malice aforethought, the engine of every drawing-room plot
One due to inherit a fortune, which makes them worth watching
Bark stopper whose pop announces the wine is open
Rubber tube carrying coolant, prone to splitting with age
Sprung hand shears closed on the vine's winter canes
Skin-and-pip compound that dries the mouth of a young red
